1.consolidated_definition: Percatarse, darse cuenta. Ser completamente consciente de algo. Desvío semántico, usual. DRAE 2001: efectuar, llevar a cabo algo. Aunque en la mayoría de los casos, los jóvenes, de primera intención, no aceptan estar deprimidos, es imposible que no se percaten de que hay algo en ellos que anda mal. La realidad del caso, es que no quieren realizar que tienen un problema que debe ser atendido lo más pronto posible (Primera Hora, CREA PR, 13-02-04)
1.en_consolidated_definition: To become aware, to realize. To be completely conscious of something. Semantic deviation, common usage. DRAE 2001: to carry out, to accomplish something. Although in most cases, young people, by first intention, do not accept being depressed, it is impossible for them not to become aware that there is something wrong with them. The reality of the case is that they do not want to realize that they have a problem that must be attended to as soon as possible (Primera Hora, CREA PR, 13-02-04)
